tasks.title: Clock & timing infrastructure
tasks.summary: src/map.js: added THREE.Clock in initMap plus module-scope animation registries (pulseObjects, capitalOrbiters, twinkleObjects). animate() now captures delta via a single clock.getDelta() per frame and reads t from clock.elapsedTime (getElapsedTime() would double-advance the clock in r128). No scene.traverse used.

tasks.title: Cloud core pulse
tasks.summary: src/map.js buildFactionClouds(): core Points layers tagged userData {animType:'cloudCore', baseOpacity:0.22, amplitude:0.05, phase:(hashString(key)%628)/100}. initMap registers all tagged cloud layers into pulseObjects; new updateAmbient(t) in animate sets opacity = base + amp*sin(t*0.35 + phase). Faction cores now breathe on an ~18s cycle.

tasks.title: Cloud halo + ring pulse
tasks.summary: src/map.js buildFactionClouds(): halo layers tagged baseOpacity 0.07 / amplitude 0.02, ring layers baseOpacity 0.35 / amplitude 0.08 with phase offset +2.0 rad vs core. All three cloud layers now pulse via the shared updateAmbient(t) loop at slightly different phases.

tasks.title: Capital orbiter particles
tasks.summary: src/map.js: new buildCapitalOrbiters(scene, systems, factions, THREE, registerFactionObj) creates a SphereGeometry(0.045,6,6) faction-coloured satellite per capital with seeded radius 0.32 / speed 0.25-0.45 / random phase. Positions updated in updateAmbient(): XZ circular orbit + 0.05 Y bob at 2x speed. Orbiters registered per faction so the filter hides them with their faction.

tasks.title: Idle camera drift
tasks.summary: src/map.js: replaced OrbitControls autoRotate with tickIdleDrift(delta). pointerdown/wheel (and programmatic zoom/fly-to via bumpAutoRotate) reset lastInteraction; after 6000ms idle the camera rotates about the target Y axis at 0.06 rad/s (~105s per revolution), preserving current zoom radius and elevation. Drift is suppressed during fly-to tweens. Removed now-unused AUTOROTATE_RESUME_MS.

tasks.title: Minor system twinkle
tasks.summary: src/map.js: minor-system Points clouds (per-faction batches in factionObjectsByKey) tagged userData {animType:'minorCloud', baseOpacity:0.55, twinklePhase: seeded random}. animate loop oscillates their material opacity +/-0.05 at t*1.8. Capital/major meshes are in separate arrays and unaffected.

tasks.title: Performance audit
tasks.summary: Audit: animate loop contains zero scene.traverse calls; all animated objects iterate dedicated arrays (pulseObjects for cloud layers, twinkleObjects for minor Points, capitalOrbiters for satellites, capitalGroups for bloom pulse). Removed per-frame Vector3 allocation + getWorldPosition in updateLabelVisibility (groups are scene-root children so .position is world space). Vite production build passes. Caveat: 60fps confirmed by code audit + headless smoke test; Chrome DevTools profiling recommended on target hardware.

tasks.title: Integration & parameter tuning
tasks.summary: Reviewed all motion together: cloud breath 0.35 rad/s (~18s), ring phase +2.0 rad, orbiters 0.25-0.45 rad/s, idle drift 0.06 rad/s, twinkle 1.8 rad/s. Also migrated the pre-existing capital bloom pulse from Date.now()*0.002 (2 rad/s strobe) to the shared clock at 0.9 rad/s so it sits between cloud breath and twinkle. Runtime verification: dev server + headless Chromium measured 165fps (uncapped monitor rate) with zero console errors.

tasks.title: Faction label sprites
tasks.summary: src/map.js: new FACTION_LABEL_POS table + buildFactionLabels(scene, factions, THREE). Each of the 7 factions gets a 512x128 canvas with its short code (UFP/KE/RSE/CU/FA/BC/DOM) in bold 52px Antonio, faction.css colour, globalAlpha 0.55 and shadowBlur 18 glow, rendered as a CanvasTexture Sprite scaled 4.0x1.0 above its primary cluster. Returns Map(key->sprite), stored as factionLabelSprites in initMap.

tasks.title: Alpha/Beta quadrant dividing line
tasks.summary: src/map.js: new buildQuadrantDivider(scene, THREE) draws a THREE.Line from (0,0,-15) to (0,0,15) with LineBasicMaterial colour 0x334466 at opacity 0.3 — the galactic meridian separating Alpha and Beta quadrants. Called from initMap right after buildGrid.

tasks.title: Quadrant watermark labels
tasks.summary: src/map.js: new buildQuadrantWatermarks(scene, THREE) renders 'ALPHA QUADRANT' at (-4,0.5,0) and 'BETA QUADRANT' at (6,0.5,0) as 1024x170 Share Tech Mono canvas sprites, colour #99AACC, material opacity 0.06, scale (12,2,1). Called from initMap after the divider line.

tasks.title: Neutral Zone border
tasks.summary: src/map.js: new buildNeutralZone(scene, THREE, factions) places SphereGeometry(0.05) markers every 0.35 units along the polyline (2,0,-1)->(4,0,-2)->(5.5,0,-3). Each marker colour is lerped from Federation blue to Romulan green by path fraction, MeshBasicMaterial opacity 0.4. Called from initMap.

tasks.title: Labels tied to faction filter
tasks.summary: src/map.js setFactionVisible(): buildFactionLabels already returns Map(key->sprite) stored as factionLabelSprites; the toggle now also sets factionLabelSprites.get(key).visible alongside system meshes and cloud layers, so hiding a faction hides its floating label.

tasks.title: Label scale with zoom
tasks.summary: src/map.js: new updateLabelScale() in animate reads camera distance from origin and maps it linearly to a 0.4x (dist<=5) ... 1.5x (dist>=15) factor applied to each label's stored baseScale (4.0,1.0), smoothed via sprite.scale.lerp(target, 0.05) with a single hoisted temp Vector3.

tasks.title: Font loading verification
tasks.summary: index.html already loads Antonio + Share Tech Mono via Google Fonts (verified, no change needed). src/map.js buildFactionLabels(): label painting extracted into a redraw closure stored on sprite.userData; document.fonts.ready repaints every label texture once webfonts finish loading, so labels render in Antonio. Arial fallback stays if the font API or CDN is unavailable (try/catch, no console spam).
